cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(dzip_native VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64)$")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "DZip numerical profile 1 requires an x86_64 AVX CPU")
endif()
# Prefer the compiler's native C++ runtime over a bundled HDF5 distribution's
# older runtime. CMake supplies these directories for the chosen toolchain.
set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH ${CMAKE_CXX_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES})
option(DZIP_SANITIZERS "Enable address and undefined behavior sanitizers" OFF)
option(DZIP_WITH_HDF5 "Enable original Keras checkpoint import" ON)
option(DZIP_WITH_CUDA "Enable native cuDNN GRU and cuBLAS bootstrap training" OFF)
set(DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Audited CUDA/cuDNN runtime root")
set(MKLDNN_LIBRARY_TYPE STATIC CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MKLDNN_THREADING SEQ CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MKLDNN_USE_MKL NONE CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MKLDNN_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MKLDNN_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WITH_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WITH_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MKLDNN_ENABLE_CONCURRENT_EXEC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ARCH_OPT_FLAGS "" CACHE STRING "Portable host code; GEMM retains its native ISA dispatch" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(third_party/mkldnn EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
# Retain diagnostics from the frozen 2019 dependency with modern compilers.
# Native port sources retain their own warning flags and sanitizer checks.
target_compile_options(mkldnn PRIVATE $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang>:-Wno-error>)
add_library(dzip_nn STATIC src/nn.cpp src/training.cpp src/cpu_ops.cpp)
set_source_files_properties(src/cpu_ops.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx")
target_include_directories(dzip_nn SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/mkldnn/include)
target_link_libraries(dzip_nn PUBLIC mkldnn)
if(DZIP_WITH_CUDA)
  enable_language(CUDA)
  find_path(DZIP_CUDNN_INCLUDE cudnn.h HINTS ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/include /usr/local/cuda/include REQUIRED)
  find_path(DZIP_CUDA_INCLUDE cuda_runtime_api.h HINTS ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/include /usr/local/cuda/include REQUIRED)
  find_library(DZIP_CUDNN_LIBRARY cudnn HINTS ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/lib ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/lib64 /usr/local/cuda/lib64 REQUIRED)
  find_library(DZIP_CUBLAS_LIBRARY cublas HINTS ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/lib ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/lib64 /usr/local/cuda/lib64 REQUIRED)
  find_library(DZIP_CUDART_LIBRARY cudart HINTS ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/lib ${DZIP_CUDA_RUNTIME_ROOT}/lib64 /usr/local/cuda/lib64 REQUIRED)
  target_sources(dzip_nn PRIVATE src/cuda_gru.cpp src/cuda_embedding.cu src/cuda_reduce.cu)
  set_target_properties(dzip_nn PROPERTIES CUDA_STANDARD 17 CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY None)
  # Stable intermediate names avoid nvcc's PID-based tmpxft STT_FILE symbol.
  target_compile_options(dzip_nn PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--fmad=false;--objdir-as-tempdir;-Xcompiler=-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}=.>)
  target_include_directories(dzip_nn SYSTEM PRIVATE ${DZIP_CUDNN_INCLUDE} ${DZIP_CUDA_INCLUDE})
  target_link_libraries(dzip_nn PUBLIC ${DZIP_CUDNN_LIBRARY} ${DZIP_CUBLAS_LIBRARY} ${DZIP_CUDART_LIBRARY})
else()
  target_sources(dzip_nn PRIVATE src/cuda_gru_stub.cpp)
endif()
if(DZIP_WITH_HDF5)
  find_package(HDF5 REQUIRED COMPONENTS C)
  target_sources(dzip_nn PRIVATE src/hdf5.cpp)
  target_include_directories(dzip_nn SYSTEM PRIVATE ${HDF5_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(dzip_nn PUBLIC ${HDF5_LIBRARIES})
else()
  target_sources(dzip_nn PRIVATE src/hdf5_stub.cpp)
endif()
target_include_directories(dzip_nn PUBLIC include)
target_include_directories(dzip_nn SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/eigen)
target_compile_features(dzip_nn PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(dzip_nn PRIVATE EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY EIGEN_DONT_PARALLELIZE EIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE)
target_compile_options(dzip_nn PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Wpedantic;-ffp-contract=off>)
add_executable(dzip_nn_cli tools/nn_cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dzip_nn_cli PRIVATE dzip_nn)
add_executable(dzip_train tools/train_cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dzip_train PRIVATE dzip_nn)
set(BSC_ROOT third_party/libbsc/libbsc)
add_library(dzip_bsc STATIC
  ${BSC_ROOT}/adler32/adler32.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/bwt/bwt.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/bwt/divsufsort/divsufsort.c
  ${BSC_ROOT}/coder/coder.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/coder/qlfc/qlfc.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/coder/qlfc/qlfc_model.cpp
  ${BSC_ROOT}/filters/detectors.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/filters/preprocessing.cpp
  ${BSC_ROOT}/libbsc/libbsc.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/lzp/lzp.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/platform/platform.cpp ${BSC_ROOT}/st/st.cpp)
set_source_files_properties(${BSC_ROOT}/bwt/divsufsort/divsufsort.c PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CXX)
target_compile_features(dzip_bsc PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(dzip_bsc PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing)
add_library(dzip STATIC src/codec.cpp)
target_include_directories(dzip PUBLIC include PRIVATE third_party/libbsc)
target_compile_features(dzip PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(dzip PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -ffp-contract=off)
target_link_libraries(dzip PUBLIC dzip_nn PRIVATE dzip_bsc)
add_executable(dzip_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dzip_cli PRIVATE dzip)
add_executable(dzip_entropy_replay tests/entropy_replay.cpp)
target_include_directories(dzip_entropy_replay PRIVATE third_party/libbsc)
target_link_libraries(dzip_entropy_replay PRIVATE dzip_nn dzip_bsc)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(dzip_preflight tests/preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dzip_preflight PRIVATE dzip Threads::Threads)
enable_testing()
add_executable(dzip_training_preflight tests/training_preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dzip_training_preflight PRIVATE dzip_nn)
add_test(NAME dzip_training_preflight COMMAND dzip_training_preflight)
add_executable(dzip_cuda_preflight tests/cuda_preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dzip_cuda_preflight PRIVATE dzip_nn Threads::Threads)
# The forced GPU test is launched explicitly on a GPU host; CUDA-disabled
# builds exercise rejection in ordinary ctest without needing a device.
if(NOT DZIP_WITH_CUDA)
  add_test(NAME dzip_cuda_unavailable COMMAND dzip_cuda_preflight)
endif()
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/alphabet-1/bootstrap.dzn")
  add_test(NAME dzip_preflight COMMAND dzip_preflight
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/alphabet-1/bootstrap.dzn
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/alphabet-2/bootstrap.dzn)
endif()
if(DZIP_SANITIZERS)
  foreach(target mkldnn dzip_nn dzip_nn_cli dzip_train dzip_training_preflight dzip_cuda_preflight dzip_bsc dzip dzip_cli dzip_preflight dzip_entropy_replay)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-pie)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -no-pie)
  endforeach()
endif()
